## Combo 1978-3301-7434--148
Cards: Brass Infiniscope + Voltaic Construct + Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh
Color identity: U | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite card draw; Near-infinite lifegain; Near-infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite draw triggers
Requires: Spell with {X} in Mana Cost (hand)
Start: Brass Infiniscope (battlefield: without summoning sickness ); Voltaic Construct (battlefield); Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh (battlefield: with two or more loyalty counters on it)
Prerequisites: There are legal targets for the spell with {X} in its mana cost, if applicable.
  You have enough mana to cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost reduced by {C}{C}, accounting for {X} to be 2 or greater if you wish to gain life.
Steps: Animate Brass Infiniscope.
  Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
  Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope.
  Repeat steps 2 and 3 as desired.
  Cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost, with {X} being at least 2 if you wish to gain life.
  Each instance of Brass Infiniscope's delayed triggered ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain half X life, rounded down, for each trigger.
Notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

## Combo 1978-4324-7434--148
Cards: Brass Infiniscope + Voltaic Construct + Workshop Elders
Color identity: U | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite card draw; Near-infinite lifegain; Near-infinite lifegain triggers; Infinite draw triggers
Requires: Spell with {X} in Mana Cost (hand)
Start: Brass Infiniscope (battlefield: without summoning sickness ); Voltaic Construct (battlefield); Workshop Elders (battlefield)
Prerequisites: There are legal targets for the spell with {X} in its mana cost, if applicable.
  You have enough mana to cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost reduced by {C}{C}, accounting for {X} to be 2 or greater if you wish to gain life.
Steps: Animate Brass Infiniscope.
  Activate Brass Infiniscope by tapping it, adding {C}{C} and creating a delayed triggered ability.
  Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Brass Infiniscope.
  Repeat steps 2 and 3 as desired.
  Cast the spell with {X} in its mana cost, with {X} being at least 2 if you wish to gain life.
  Each instance of Brass Infiniscope's delayed triggered ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain half X life, rounded down, for each trigger.
Notes: Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

Produces: Infinite turns; Skip your draw steps; Lock
Start: Ghostly Flicker (hand); Mystic Sanctuary (battlefield); Temporal Manipulation (hand); Donnie & April, Adorkable Duo (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
Steps: Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
  Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Donnie & April.
  When Donnie & April and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
  Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
  Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
  Repeat.

Steps: Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
  When the Donnie & April token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
  Repeat.

## Combo 6995-7009-7068
Cards: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk + Lulu, Stern Guardian + Baboon Spirit
Color identity: U | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 3 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {6}{U}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk (battlefield); Lulu, Stern Guardian (battlefield); Baboon Spirit (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
  Activate Baboon Spirit by paying {3}{U}, exiling Avatar Kuruk.
  At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, returning The Legend of Kuruk from exile to the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
  The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
  Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
  Activate Lulu by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
  The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
  Repeat.
